title: The Comment Strategy: 30 Minutes a Day Beats Another Post
description: Commenting on other accounts drives more profile visits than publishing again. Here is the exact 30-minute daily routine that works on Instagram and TikTok.
excerpt: Everyone obsesses over what to post. Almost nobody thinks about where to be visible between posts.
content:
Everyone obsesses over what to post. Almost nobody thinks about where to be visible between posts.

## Why comments outperform another post

Your post reaches people who already follow you. Your comment under an account with 50,000 followers reaches people who have never heard of you. That is the whole difference — a comment borrows somebody else's audience.

Instagram and TikTok also rank comments by engagement. If your comment collects 40 likes, it sits at the top of that post for hours. For free.

## How to actually do it

**Pick 15 accounts.** Not random ones — accounts your exact target audience already follows. Turn on post notifications for all of them.

**Comment within 10 minutes of publishing.** Early comments have the best shot at floating to the top.

**Write 2-3 sentences, not emoji.** Nobody likes "Great post!" A specific observation, your own experience, or an added detail — that is what earns likes and profile clicks.

**Hold 30 minutes a day.** Fifteen in the morning, fifteen at night. After three weeks your Insights will show the profile-visit curve bending up.

## Where it breaks

If someone clicks through to a profile with 40 followers and an empty grid, they leave. So pair it with both: content worth clicking, and baseline social proof. Try it for a week. No ads, no budget — just comments.
